transcript_raw:
Participant: P04 | Session 1 | Cyberpunk 2077 | full HUD | Interviewer: Researcher 2
[00:00] Interviewer: Okay [name], thanks. Let's start the interview for session 1.
[00:10] Interviewer: Q1. How did you figure out where to go during the session? What did you look at or rely on?
[00:16] P04: uh, you know, I kept you know, looking at the waypoint marker and drove toward it.
[00:39] Interviewer: Q2. Were there moments when something on the screen confused you? What was happening?
[00:45] P04: uh, um, not really, everything was pretty clear.
[01:17] Interviewer: Q3. Which HUD elements, if any, pulled your attention away from what you were doing?
[01:22] P04: um, uh, [silence 4s] my eyes kept going like, to the minimap corner instead of the road.
[01:54] Interviewer: Q4. Was there any HUD element that didn't work the way you expected?
[01:58] P04: um, uhm [silence 4s] the marker got confusing when I was like, inside a building.
[02:26] Interviewer: Q5. How aware were you of the passing of time while playing?
[02:34] P04: like, uh, honestly time went by fast.
[03:10] Interviewer: Q6. Was there a point where you had to stop to figure out what the game was telling you?
[03:16] P04: like, um, [silence 4s] no, I uh, never really had to stop, the map told me everything.
[03:49] Interviewer: Q7. What information, if any, did you feel was missing from the screen?
[03:54] P04: um, uhm nothing was missing, if anything there uh, was too much. My friend [name] told me it's the same in other games.
[04:09] Interviewer: Q8. What would you change about the HUD you just used, and why?
[04:13] P04: you know, uhm I would ahh, make the HUD smaller and remove some of the notifications. Like I said, I'm [participant], I play this at home.
